name: How long does it take to install an easy grip faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an easy grip faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for an easy grip faucet can vary depending on whether it's a new installation or a replacement, and the existing plumbing configuration. Generally, a straightforward replacement in a typical kitchen or bathroom sink can take between 1 to 3 hours. More complex installations involving modifications to plumbing lines or sink cutouts might extend the time. Our experienced technicians aim for efficient, precise installation to minimize disruption.
